caption: The drawing features three distinct objects, all resembling miniature houses. The largest object, located in the lower left corner, is a detailed representation of a small house with a yellow exterior, a red slanted roof, a prominent red chimney, and windows marked in black and white. The house also includes a circular window or ornament above its door and a slot on the side of the roof. The second object, in the upper center, is a much smaller, yellow, house-like structure with a dark base, a triangular roof, two small dark windows, and a single door. The third object, situated near the upper right part of the image, also resembles a house with a distinct yellow and brown front, a sharply peaked red roof, visible black slots, and a black keyhole-like feature on its face. The background is plain and light-colored, with the objects seemingly floating and not interacting with each other.
title: Tiled Roof House Bank
